description: Proposes that two exports (artifacts) contain the same chatbot conversation. Primary evidence: the importer's logical records (logical_records/logical_occurrences: one conversation id observed in several exports), with per-record content differences (edits, regenerations) and records not observed in one export. Fallback for importers without logical records: identical thread_id and chatbot on chat events of different artifacts. Absence is 'not observed', never deletion.

right.selector: another export file containing the same conversation id

criteria.logical_record: gate (primary): one logical conversation record with occurrences in two exports (identity asserted by the source's own conversation id, recorded by the importer)
criteria.records: evidence: message records shared, with differing content hashes, or observed in only one export
criteria.conversation_content: evidence: conversation-level content hash (title) equal or not
criteria.thread_id: gate (fallback): identical thread_id and chatbot on events without logical occurrences
criteria.message_times: evidence: first/last projected time of the conversation's events in each export
